evidence_note: These deterministic candidates are transcribed from Chinese Wikisource juan 2. The source page does not identify a base facsimile or collation, so all rules are evidence grade D until checked character by character against a dated edition and reviewed in Chinese.

conclusion.if_intercalary: use the following lunar month number for life/body palace placement

exceptions: The transcription does not establish whether month 12 wraps to month 1 or whether later schools subdivide an intercalary month; both require facsimile and school evidence.
This normalization is limited to the stated life/body palace operation and must not silently alter every month-dependent star rule.
rules.publication_limit: Do not call this the universal Zi Wei leap-month rule. Display the Quanshu source profile and suppress the chart if an unresolved month-12 or school variant changes placement.

conclusion.month_anchor: place lunar month 1 at Yin and count branches forward to chart lunar month
conclusion.hour_anchor: treat the resulting month palace as Zi hour
conclusion.life_palace: count branches backward from the month palace to the birth double-hour
conclusion.body_palace: count branches forward from the month palace to the birth double-hour

exceptions: Branch indexing, inclusivity and the Zi-hour civil-time boundary require explicit golden examples and cannot be inferred from a modern calculator.
The adjusted month must come from the source-scoped leap-month rule rather than a generic Chinese calendar library default.
